title: Morice River FSR 4656-01 (September 4, 2026)
source_text: Morice River FSR 4656-01 (September 4, 2026): There is a failing culvert at 33 km on the Morice River FSR which has caused a hole in the running surface of the road. It has been marked by a passerby with a branch inserted into the hole. Due to wet weather and log-hauling, the entire Morice road network is exhibiting righter running surface than what travelers might be used to. Use caution when driving the Morice road network.
